wps.title: WP 2.1's second slice: the precondition kinds only the plan's statements show, matched by a vocabulary that is data, and the planter's witnesses for them
wps.brief: Build the second slice of WP 2.1 of V3_MILESTONES.md (§8, its row in full; §3.1; §4 row 20). The first slice (kernel/Preconditions.cs, kernel/Coordinates.cs, kernel/Outcome.cs, kernel/ColumnType.cs) holds TableEmpty, NotNull, Fits, ForeignKey, Unique and Check from the property read. This slice adds the kinds only the plan's statements show: KeyLength, Rebuild, Computed, Temporal, Scan, Authored and SeedDrift, each matched on io's typed statements of DacFx's plan by a vocabulary row, which is data, so io hands the kernel statements and the kernel references nothing but the BCL; an Authored or Computed state is declared by a person, never counted; a statement that reads existing rows and matches no row is an unclassified change routed to proof. Spike S2 measured the statement shapes on both DacFx releases: read DECISIONS.md's 2026-10-19 line on the Facsimile's §11 question 3 (the four refinements for WP 2.1), S2's notes in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-outsystems-ddl-exporter/17755096-5809-5c10-a22d-d46e8371455a/scratchpad/specs/s2-notes.txt (the shapes, and the statements that need rows that read nothing or 'Unknown stops' fires on every plan: the Query Store block, #tmpErrors, @@ERROR and @@TRANCOUNT, PRINT, SET, WAITFOR DELAY, the #__checkStatus cursor, the DEFAULT drop and re-add around ALTER COLUMN, __RefactorLog and CREATE ROLE), and the Facsimile's vocabulary (archive/v2/ssdt-agent/facsimile/ARCHITECTURE.md §4) and cases (cases/10-questions.md for these kinds). io's statements come from WP 2.2's reader (io/BlockOnPossibleDataLoss*.cs, tests/Io.Tests/BlockOnPossibleDataLossChecks.cs's Statements listing, every statement recursing into IF, BEGIN...END and TRY...CATCH). Then extend the planter (kernel/Witness*.cs, WP 3.8, on the base) so each new kind that needs a witness gets its case, from cases/20-planter.md; where a witness cannot be planted from ordinal literals, the plan names planter-needs-row. The precondition kinds are a closed set: every switch over them stays exhaustive. Done when: every pure case of cases/10-questions.md and cases/20-planter.md for these kinds passes, its case identifier in the test name or InlineData; the vocabulary rows run over every sample change's plan from both releases (the S2 fixture's plans) without an 'Unknown stops' on a statement S2 listed as reading nothing; V3_PARITY.md PAR-215 (the Authored and SeedDrift kinds) names the tests. Per-file budget: 500 lines a code file, 140 characters a line; put the new kinds in files of their own rather than growing Preconditions.cs past 500.

wps.title: io/SyntheticCopy and synthetic-copy up: the copy build's eight steps, at the existing-data tier
wps.brief: Build WP 3.5 of V3_MILESTONES.md (§9; read its row in full, §3.1, §4 rows 13 (as corrected on 2026-10-19), 16, 19 to 21, and the Facsimile's archive/v2/ssdt-agent/facsimile/ARCHITECTURE.md §5, the copy build, steps 1 to 8, with archive/v2/TWIN_SUCCESSION.md, which the operator asked builders of M3 to read). io/SyntheticCopy and the verb `synthetic-copy up [--at <ref>] [--existing-data <file>]`: 1, restore the base from the cache (io/LocalServer's BackUp and Restore, WP 3.4), on a miss build at the ref (M1), create a database named dbchange_synthetic_<16 hex of the base's fingerprint over the package, the profile, DacFx and the server>_existing-data[_<16 hex of the existing data's fingerprint>] under a lock file in .dbchange/ (FileLock.Take), publish under the pipeline's profile with drop-not-in-source so the post-deploy seeds run, and back it up; 2 and 3, plant WP 3.8's rows (kernel Witness, on the base): presence rows, then violating rows, in Order's order, as ScriptDom INSERTs; 4, reproduce the environment's trust state: a constraint the environment holds untrusted or disabled is suspended to plant and restored exactly, reading is_not_trusted and is_disabled from the catalog through SqlServer.Measure, as spike S9's receipts require (a schema read keeps trust only as an internal annotation), never forcing trust (the Twin's post-mint trust gate turned a block into a wrong clean); 5, run the change's declared witnesses, DML only, inside the same suspend-and-restore envelope, from a DML file committed on the change's branch at a path this package fixes, a literal neither synthetic nor defined by the repository's model refused and a failing row refused by its line; 6, hash every touched and every seeded table; 7, accept: count the copy over its own plan's preconditions (WP 2.3's io/AggregateQueries through Measure) and require the environment's ExistingData answer for answer, every no included, refusing a copy that misses one and naming the precondition; 8, identity: the plan from the base to the copy is empty, a check written with IN read as kernel/Plan.cs CheckWrittenWithIn names it (the operator's ruling of 2026-10-19). The base is never re-published after planting. No state table. planter-needs-row and a failed acceptance are the agent's next step: the operator ruled on 2026-10-19 that this is exit 8 needs-input, added to cli/exits.frozen and cli/Contract.cs by the change that first raises one, which is this one if the verb surfaces it. The verb's --help text and its JSON schema under cli/schemas/ land in the same commit (AGENTS.md). Done when: after `synthetic-copy up --at <the golden project's base>`, `check drift --target synthetic-copy --at <that ref>` exits 0; a copy missing one witness fails acceptance naming the precondition; a copy built with an ExistingData holding each of R6's sites (rows, a null, an orphan, a duplicate, a value over the new length) answers every precondition as given, its plan from the base empty; the golden project with a multi-table view builds its copy (V3_PARITY.md PAR-148). Update V3_PARITY.md's rows this holds (PAR-033 the declared witnesses, PAR-034 the trust step, PAR-148 the view), keeping clauses that wait on WP 3.6 or WP 4.x in the grammar ParityResolves accepts. Safety: a copy is made only through the registry; Publish exists only on a Copy; no row value from an environment reaches a copy (the ExistingData is booleans; witnesses are synthetic or the repository's own literals); the declared witnesses are DML only. Per-file budget: 500 lines a code file, 140 characters a line; Appendix F plans io's M3 at 950 lines with LocalServer and Profile.

wps.title: WP 2.6: the corpus begins, and the Facsimile's case catalog moves to tests/Cases/
wps.brief: Build WP 2.6 of V3_MILESTONES.md (§8, its row in full; §3.1; V3_PARITY.md §3, whose PAR-101 to PAR-148 rows are v2's proof-lane facts each becoming a sample change). Two parts. (1) The corpus: tests/Golden/changes/<operation>/ holds, per sample change, the edit to the golden project (the edits.txt format the folders already use, with classify.txt from WP 2.4), the expected preconditions, and the expected prediction on an empty, a populated and a violating copy; seed it from v2's SamplePr* facts (archive/v2/tests/Twin.Tests.Integration/SamplePr*Tests.fs, the PAR-1xx rows' v2 cells) and the Facsimile's four operations files (archive/v2/ssdt-agent/facsimile/cases/40-ops-columns.md to 43-compound.md); the copies are populated by plain INSERT scripts under tests/Golden/ until the planter replaces them (it has landed as kernel Witness; WP 3.5 plants with it in this same wave, so prefer the planter's plan where WP 3.5's io is not needed, and plain INSERTs otherwise); the sample changes so far run in one parameterized test. The golden corpus holds 3,000 lines in all (ci/budgets.json golden): measure, and if the corpus cannot fit, say so with the figure rather than squeezing it. (2) The move: the Facsimile's case catalog (archive/v2/ssdt-agent/facsimile/cases/), its INVARIANTS.md and ARCHITECTURE.md move to tests/Cases/ by git mv, with their ci/docs.manifest.json rows and a budget row of their own in ci/budgets.json set by a DECISIONS.md line at the move (the catalog is about 19,500 lines); their citations are fixed for the move; their restated counts point to the generated traceability matrix; and archive/v2/ssdt-agent/facsimile/tests/catalog_lint.py becomes a test in tests/Budgets.Tests that also regenerates the matrix. The move edits archive/ because the plan's WP 2.6 says it does and the 2026-10-19 decision line parks the catalog there until this package; v2's ssdt-agent gates workflow runs the catalog lint on the archive path, so keep that lane green by pointing its step at tests/Cases/ or removing the step now that Budgets.Tests runs the lint, with a decision line, and touch nothing else in v2's workflows. Every V3_PARITY.md row and every document that cites a moved file is updated in the same commit, and ParityResolves, Citations and Manifest stay green. Done when: the sample changes so far run in one parameterized test; the catalog's lint is green as a C# test; V3_PARITY.md's '(not held yet: WP 2.6)' clauses name what holds them now.
